timing.reason: Freeze interpretation and next-route boundaries before B10/O11/control results reveal the complete pattern.

R1_STRUCTURAL_FAILURE_IF_REVEALED.trigger: Any remaining A0 class reveals failed exact identity, fail-closed behavior, nonzero runtime-oracle use, sign mismatch or provider construction failure.
R1_STRUCTURAL_FAILURE_IF_REVEALED.route: Treat as implementation/representation correctness first. Do not infer material-shape physics from a structurally invalid candidate.

R2_SCALAR_NORMALIZATION_GENERALIZATION_F.trigger: The forced negative tail result remains the dominant pattern without structural failure.
R2_SCALAR_NORMALIZATION_GENERALIZATION_F.route: Reject one-scalar alpha or h50 endpoint normalization as the next full-catalog family. Do not repair it with material-specific scale factors selected from A0 rows.

R3_MATERIAL_SHAPE_DEPENDENT_FAILURE.trigger: Remaining B10/O11 results align with the already revealed B17/B18/O07 low-NPAR/broad-transition pattern.
R3_MATERIAL_SHAPE_DEPENDENT_FAILURE.route: A future hypothesis may represent constitutive curve shape explicitly rather than by one scale, but the coordinate/algorithm must be specified globally before testing. NPAR<=1.2 is characterization only and cannot become a threshold from these data.
permitted_future_hypothesis_classes_not_: analytically shape-aware endpoint coordinate using source hydraulic parameters without learned thresholds
globally specified bounded adaptive interpolation-defect placement independent of validation rows
higher-order constrained endpoint representation preserving exact hydraulic identities
R3_MATERIAL_SHAPE_DEPENDENT_FAILURE.forbidden: No material-name lookup, no hand-inserted knots at observed failing heads, no revealed-error-trained regime classifier.

R4_GEOMETRY_SENSITIVE_SUBPATTERN.trigger: O01/O05 retain strong improvement while low-NPAR tail classes fail.
R4_GEOMETRY_SENSITIVE_SUBPATTERN.route: Keep geometry sensitivity as a separate representation requirement. Do not assume the coordinate that fixes 20 cm strong gradients also generalizes material transition shape.

R5_F_SI09_PROVIDER_RECONCILIATION.trigger: Before any new physical qualification against the admitted SWAP5 default-MvG route.
R5_F_SI09_PROVIDER_RECONCILIATION.route: Bind or independently cross-qualify against exact F-SI09 corrected B1.10 provider/blob. Recharacterize only what is needed to know whether legacy C7a/A0 failure localization survives the corrected provider; do not independently modify constitutive formulas in F-LMFP.

R6_INDEPENDENT_ROSS_CROSS_EVIDENCE.trigger: F-ROSS01 independently closes a face-representation subgate with comparable hydraulic cases.
R6_INDEPENDENT_ROSS_CROSS_EVIDENCE.route: Use only as cross-evidence after lineage is explicit. Do not copy Ross table/oracle implementation into F-LMFP or vice versa. If both streams converge on the same abstract provider requirements, route any shared production contract through a separate solver-neutral integration/owner workunit.

control_panel_interpretation.if_controls_remain_good: Scalar normalization is not globally destructive but still fails the target low-NPAR tail family; this does not rescue A0.
control_panel_interpretation.if_controls_degrade: Strengthens rejection of the scalar-normalization family; do not tune control-specific exceptions.

next_workunit_rule: Do not open a new representation implementation branch while F-ROSS01 is actively changing the same broad steady-face design space. First close A0 and review the then-current Ross and F-SI09 boundaries. A new F-LMFP workunit is justified only for a non-overlapping materially new hypothesis.
